method: Google Vertex AI (project arborprd-westeu, global endpoint) image generation; two candidates per picture (gemini-3-pro-image and gemini-3.1-flash-image), the better one chosen by eye; centre-cropped and exported to 480/960 WebP. Direction approved by Guy 9 Oct 2026: real objects that carry each area's meaning, drawn in the Arbor mark's language (leaf, arch, circle; its four gradients; translucent overlaps) on one brand shape.
rules: Decorative only; abstract or object-only, never a child, a face or a family's own activity; no text.

Sophisticated, modern editorial brand illustration for a premium parenting app. No text, letters, numbers, faces, eyes, people, hands or animals.
